description: Prepare an unpaid /v1/announcements/history request and check matching data. Returns count and x402 requirements, never paid records. Binance listing and announcement history by year since 2017, for backtests.

coin.description: Optional ticker such as BTC, ETH, NVDA or EURUSD, matched against the AI-tagged coins and the tickers named in each record.

event.description: Optional: listings keeps new tokens, new trading pairs and futures launches; delistings keeps token delistings and trading pair removals.

year.description: A calendar year from 2017, YYYY. The free /health lists the years on sale.

name: quote_getAnnouncementHistory
